latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Audio to Subtitle Generator.

- Instantly converts spoken audio from video files (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv) into accurate, time-synced subtitles (SRT, VTT).
- Cloud-backed transcription with automatic setup and streamlined authentication (includes 100 free credits on first sign-in).
- Simple file upload and subtitle export process with support for user requests and format preferences.
- Real-time status updates and built-in error handling for common issues (authentication, file size, unsupported formats).
- Designed for content creators, educators, accessibility, and fast video workflows.
